text:
tara-people-ops: Heads-up: annual attestation window opens next week. Were doing a short evidence recon + final upload sprint for SOC2 + ISO artifacts. Please review the new filename convention and upload checklist before EOD Wednesday. Office hours Thu 9:30am PT in #help (15m drop-in). :calendar:

noah-eng: New filename convention? where is that doc?

tara-people-ops: short link: https://go/reports/attestation2026 (has examples). Quick summary below and pasted checklist at the end.

vivian-security: Two quick policy notes: 1) Any artifact with sensitive customer data must be encrypted at rest with your team KMS and include `kms_key=<key-id>` in the metadata. 2) Logs that show user identifiers should be redacted or replaced with placeholders before upload.

alex-legal: Also: contractual exhibits should not be uploaded in full. Submit a redacted extract + a secure link (shared only with Legal + Compliance). If in doubt, ping me.

noah-eng: If a ticket references an incident with PII, do we attach the full ticket PDF or create an excerpt?

vivian-security: Create an excerpt showing steps & controls, redact PII, and attach the excerpt. If the auditor requires the full ticket well coordinate a secure review. Mark the artifact with `sensitive:needs-review` if you think full access may be necessary.

rachel-ops: Quick checklist (copyable):

```
- Filename: <team>_<control>_<YYYYMMDD>_<v1>.pdf
- S3 path: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2026/attest/<TEAM>/
- Tags: SOC2:CC-6.3, ISO:A.7.1
- Owner: @<owner>
- Redaction: yes/no (describe fields redacted)
- Encryption: kms_key=<key-id> or public=false
- Notes: one-line description + related ticket IDs
```

tara-people-ops: Timeline: evidence recon (identify & prepare) by Monday EOD, final uploads by Wednesday EOD. If you need a team-level extension, request via the compliance queue and cc me.

noah-eng: Happy to make a tiny script to validate filenames + tags. I can open a PR to `infra-tools` with a pre-commit hook.

tara-people-ops: appreciate it — please ping @vivian-security for the hook review.

compliance-bot: Reminder: Attestation evidence window opens in 48 hours. Assigned owners will receive email prompts.

alex-legal: One more legal note: if your artifact contains third-party customer data, confirm you have the right to include it for audits. If not, create a sanitized extract and note the limitation in the metadata.

rachel-ops: If anyone wants me to create a shared Drive folder template + a sample redaction script, DM me and Ill drop it in your team's Drive by EOD today.

noah-eng: Uploading two artifacts to my prefix now, tagging SOC2 and ISO as requested.

tara-people-ops: thanks team — will close the thread after office hours and post the decision log for edge cases.
